_comment: Reactive mpd commentary. Matching order: artist tag (name/aliases/folders), composer keywords (regex on composer/title/album), performers, album artist, folder name, fallback. eyes: open/half/closed, held while the line types out, then normal blinking resumes; only for sprites with separate eye layers.

fallback.text: - Who is this? Don't tell me. I'll pretend I've always known them.

artists.name: Andrew Jackson Jihad
artists.text: - A whole song about being brave while everything is terrible? He's describing my Tuesday!

artists.name: Anna von Hausswolff
artists.text: - A church organ... It's so big it could swallow my whole room. And us with it.

artists.name: A Tribe Called Quest
artists.text: - Can I kick it? No, you can't. You'd trip over the fan cable again.

artists.name: Bauhaus
artists.text: - Bela Lugosi's dead? Good. Then he can't climb out of my wardrobe tonight.

artists.name: Beck
artists.text: - He keeps calling himself a loser. If you say something that many times, it turns into a promise.

artists.name: Black Wing
artists.text: - Doomed? Me too! Let's start a club. I'll count the money, you can't even count down five minutes.

artists.name: British Sea Power
artists.text: - I've never seen the sea. I think it's just a very big bathtub that nobody ever drains.

artists.name: Burzum
artists.text: - This sounds like it was recorded in a cold basement. I don't want to meet whoever lives down there.

artists.name: Cabaret Voltaire
artists.text: - Tape loops and buzzing. It's like the fan in my room finally learned how to be angry.

artists.name: Car Seat Headrest
artists.text: - This song is longer than my attention span, and it still hasn't said what it wanted to say.

artists.name: Chet Baker
artists.text: - He sings so softly, like he's scared of waking someone up. Maybe me.

artists.name: Childish Gambino
artists.text: - Stay woke? I'm trying to fall asleep here!

artists.name: Count Basie and his Orchestra
artists.text: - So many trumpets! If they all played in my room, the posters would fall off the walls.

artists.name: Crywank
artists.text: - Tomorrow is nearly yesterday and everything is stupid. Finally, someone who reads my diary!

artists.name: D.N.A.
artists.text: - Is he tuning the guitar or playing it? Don't tell me. I want to keep guessing.

artists.name: Daughters
artists.text: - You won't get what you want? I know. They didn't have to write it on the cover.

artists.name: David Bowie
artists.text: - Ground control to... me! Ehehe. If I float away, don't forget to feed my fireflies.

artists.name: Deafheaven
artists.text: - The cover is pink and the man is screaming. I don't know which one to believe.

artists.name: Death Cab For Cutie
artists.text: - 'I need you so much closer'... Then why are you sitting all the way over there?

artists.name: Death Grips
artists.text: - Why is he yelling at me? I didn't even do anything today! Well, almost nothing.

artists.name: Earth
artists.text: - Bees made honey inside a lion's skull. I bet it tastes like thinking too much.

artists.name: Echo And The Bunnymen
artists.text: - The killing moon... It looked through my window once. I pretended to be asleep.

artists.name: Einstürzende Neubauten
artists.text: - They're hitting pipes with hammers. Is this music, or are the neighbors fixing the radiator again?

artists.name: Elliott Smith
artists.text: - He whispers everything. Like a secret for someone who already left.

artists.name: flatsound
artists.text: - Did everything feel beautiful when I let go of being anything at all? ...Ask me tomorrow.

artists.name: Galaxy News Radio
artists.text: - The world ended and the radio still plays love songs. That's sweet. Or really, really sad.

artists.name: Giles Corey
artists.text: - More weight...? Is that what you're putting on me? It's heavy enough already, thank you!

artists.name: Godspeed You! Black Emperor
artists.text: - This song is twenty minutes long. By the end, I'll forget how the beginning went.

artists.name: Haken
artists.text: - They keep changing the rhythm! I tried counting along and now my numbers don't add up.

artists.name: Have a Nice Life
artists.text: - 'Have a nice life'... People only say that when they're leaving for good.

artists.name: Iggy Pop
artists.text: - Lust for life! I have some too. It's in the drawer, next to my pills.

artists.name: James Chance & The Contortions
artists.text: - The saxophone sounds like somebody is stepping on it. Someone help the poor thing!

artists.name: Jeff Buckley
artists.text: - Hallelujah... Mom used to sing it wrong on purpose. I liked her version better.

artists.name: John Maus
artists.text: - 'We must become the pitiless censors of ourselves.' That sounds like something my pills would say.

artists.name: Joy Division
artists.text: - Love will tear us apart? Then I'll just stay in my room. Nothing gets torn in here.

artists.name: Julia Brown
artists.text: - An abundance of strawberries! That's the nicest thing to sing about. Can we have some?

artists.name: Kanye West
artists.text: - He thinks he's the smartest person in the room. He hasn't been in my room.

artists.name: Katawa Shoujo
artists.text: - Music from another visual novel? You're listening to other girls' soundtracks now? Hmph!

artists.name: Kavinsky
artists.text: - Driving through the city at night... I'd get carsick. I don't like where cars take you.

artists.name: Kendrick Lamar
artists.text: - 'We gon' be alright.' He sounds so sure. I wish he'd say it to me personally.

artists.name: KIDS SEE GHOSTS
artists.text: - Kids see ghosts? Of course we do. Grown-ups just pretend they don't.

artists.name: King Crimson
artists.text: - The court of the Crimson King... I don't want to be invited. They'd make me sit still for hours.

artists.name: Lil Peep
artists.text: - Crybaby... Are you calling me that? I only cried twice today. Three times, if the pills count.

artists.name: Low
artists.text: - Everything is so slow and quiet. If I sing along, I'll fall asleep halfway through a word.

artists.name: Low Roar
artists.text: - It sounds like snow falling somewhere far away. Somewhere nobody would ever find you.

artists.name: Mac DeMarco
artists.text: - He sounds like he's never been in a hurry in his whole life. I'd be so jealous!

artists.name: Madrugada
artists.text: - Industrial silence? That's my room at three in the morning. Except for the fan.

artists.name: Madvillain
artists.text: - He wears a mask all the time? Smart. Then nobody knows what stupid face he's making.

artists.name: Mars
artists.text: - Mars is so far away. This is what it sounds like when you get there and nobody's waiting.

artists.name: Matt Elliott
artists.text: - Are you drinking yourself to sleep again...?

artists.name: Maximum the Hormone
artists.text: - They're screaming in Japanese! I don't understand a single word, but I agree with all of it!

artists.name: M. Gira
artists.text: - He's all alone this time, without the rest of the Swans. Somehow that's scarier.

artists.name: Miracle Musical
artists.text: - There are secret messages hidden in these songs. Maybe if you play them backwards, they'll finally make sense.

artists.name: My Bloody Valentine
artists.text: - Everything is blurry, like when I rub my eyes too hard. I kind of like it.

artists.name: Nadja
artists.text: - Skin turns to glass? Then everyone could see what's inside me. No thank you!

artists.name: Neutral Milk Hotel
artists.text: - Milk hotel?! You're doing this on purpose. I'm not staying in a hotel full of milk!

artists.name: New Order
artists.text: - How does it feel to treat me like you do? ...Ehehe, I'm just singing along. Unless it's true.

artists.name: Nine Inch Nails
artists.text: - A downward spiral... I've been on those stairs before. They don't end at the bottom.

artists.name: Nujabes
artists.text: - People study to this music. So why can't I remember a single thing I learned today?

artists.name: Pink Floyd
artists.text: - All those clocks ringing at once! Turn it off, I can't look at clock hands for too long.

artists.name: Pixies
artists.text: - Where is my mind? I had it a second ago. It's probably hiding with the fireflies.

artists.name: Queen
artists.text: - Is this the real life? Is this just fantasy? ...I've been asking myself that all night.

artists.name: Radiohead
artists.text: - Everything in its right place. Just like my room! Don't you dare move anything.

artists.name: R. Kelly
artists.text: - No. Not him. Skip it right now.

artists.name: Run The Jewels
artists.text: - They sound like they'd win any argument. Even one against Mom.

artists.name: Ryo Fukui
artists.text: - A letter from a slow boat... It must take years to arrive. I'd wait for it, though.

artists.name: Sigur Rós
artists.text: - He's singing in a language that doesn't exist. I understand it perfectly.

artists.name: Siouxsie and The Banshees
artists.text: - Spellbound... If someone put a spell on me, would anyone notice the difference?

artists.name: Sonic Youth
artists.text: - A whole nation of daydreams? I'd move there. I already speak the language.

artists.name: Sparklehorse
artists.text: - 'It's a wonderful life,' he says. It sounds like he's trying to convince himself.

artists.name: Spektr
artists.text: - The art to disappear... I'm practicing. Close your eyes and count to ten.

artists.name: Subpar Pianist
artists.text: - You're missing some notes. That's okay. I miss some thoughts all the time.

artists.name: Old piano recordings
artists.text: - Is this you on the piano? You sound so little! Don't worry, I won't tell anyone. Probably.

artists.name: Endeha Studios
artists.text: - You made this? Little bleeps for a game about sneaking around... I bet you hid in a cardboard box the whole time.

artists.name: Matija Barac
artists.text: - He really wanted to sound like Pink Floyd. Where is he now? ...You don't know either, do you?

artists.name: Suicide
artists.text: - Just a cheap organ and someone yelling about ghost riders. I'm not listening to the long one again!

artists.name: Sunn O)))
artists.text: - It's one note. It's been one note for five minutes. I think the walls are humming back.

artists.name: Swans
artists.text: - Swans again? You have more Swans than anything else. That's not a hobby anymore, that's a problem.

artists.name: Talking Heads
artists.text: - 'This is not my beautiful house.' It's not my beautiful room either. It's just a room.

artists.name: Teenage Jesus And The Jerks
artists.text: - That song was over before I understood it. Just like a school day.

artists.name: teen suicide
artists.text: - Everything sounds recorded through a pillow. Like someone wanted to scream without waking anyone.

artists.name: The Angelic Process
artists.text: - Weighing souls with sand? Mine would slip right through the scale.

artists.name: Angels of Light
artists.text: - How I loved you... Why does everyone sing about love like it already happened?

artists.name: The Antlers
artists.text: - This album smells like a hospital. I know that smell. Can we listen to something else, please?

artists.name: The Buggles
artists.text: - Video killed the radio star, and my laptop killed all my friends. Nobody ever gets punished!

artists.name: The Cure
artists.text: - A lullaby about a spider that eats you? Who sings that to a kid before bed?!

artists.name: The Dave Brubeck Quartet
artists.text: - Take five! One, two, three, four, five... See? I can count to five. Minutes are harder.

artists.name: The Microphones
artists.text: - The glow! Like fireflies. Maybe he's looking for his, too.

artists.name: The National
artists.text: - His voice is so low, it sounds like he's talking from under the bed. Are you under the bed?

artists.name: The Smiths
artists.text: - Heaven knows I'm miserable now? Heaven should mind its own business.

artists.name: The Stooges
artists.text: - 'I wanna be your dog'? What a weird thing to want. I already told you, you're not my pet.

artists.name: The Twilight Sad
artists.text: - Nobody wants to be here and nobody wants to leave. That's exactly how bedtime works.

artists.name: The Velvet Underground
artists.text: - 'I'll be your mirror.' No thanks. My mirror already has enough opinions.

artists.name: Tiny Little Houses
artists.text: - A snow globe... A tiny house where nothing changes, and someone shakes it when they're bored. Like my room!

artists.name: Tom Waits
artists.text: - His voice sounds like gravel in a bucket. I like him! He sounds like he keeps candy in his coat.

artists.name: Tropical Fuck Storm
artists.text: - I'm not saying that band name out loud. Mom might hear.

artists.name: Ulcerate
artists.text: - Shrines of paralysis! It's so loud I can't move at all. Maybe that's the point.

artists.name: Wire
artists.text: - That song lasted a minute. Are they in a hurry, or am I just slow today?

artists.name: Yellow Swans
artists.text: - It's all static. That's the sound in my head right before I finally fall asleep.

artists.name: Агата Кристи
artists.text: - Opium... They sing it like a fairy tale. Grown-ups always tell the scariest fairy tales.

artists.name: Кино
artists.text: - A blood type on my sleeve? I don't even know my blood type. The doctors never tell me anything.

artists.name: Beethoven
artists.text: - He wrote all this after he went deaf. I stopped hearing my own thoughts too, but I didn't get a symphony out of it.

artists.name: Mozart
artists.text: - Mozart wrote music when he was younger than me. I only wrote a list of reasons not to sleep.

artists.name: Chopin
artists.text: - Chopin always sounds like he's apologizing. I don't know what for. Maybe for the funeral march.

artists.name: Liszt
artists.text: - Liebestraum means 'love dream'. I only have regular dreams. Well, I used to.

artists.name: Debussy
artists.text: - Clair de lune... I used to watch the moonlight crawl across my floor until I fell asleep.

artists.name: Tchaikovsky
artists.text: - Cannons, flowers and dancing swans. He put everything in there. You like swans, don't you?

artists.name: Schumann
artists.text: - Scenes from childhood. It's so gentle. Mine didn't sound like that.

artists.name: Schubert
artists.text: - An impromptu? He made it up on the spot? I make things up on the spot too, and nobody writes them down.

artists.name: Yann Tiersen
artists.text: - This song is about someone else's summer. Can I borrow it?

artists.name: Fritz Kreisler
artists.text: - Liebesleid means 'love's sorrow'. It always comes right after the love dream. Makes sense.
